original_test_intent: Verify the explicitly approved IOMMU-disabled mode is active and amdgpu loads and binds every expected GPU without boot, DMA, driver, PCIe or XGMI errors.
original_method: Apply/confirm the user-owned BIOS or kernel disablement under a security exception, reboot through the approved recovery plan, then correlate firmware/cmdline/runtime state with complete GPU binding and log evidence.
manual_activity: Operator applies or supervises the approved security-sensitive configuration and reboot; engineer resolves duplicate identity and any mode, DMA, binding or log discrepancy and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Approved BIOS/kernel IOMMU-disabled definition and expected cmdline
Supported kernel/amdgpu/ROCm/firmware baseline and eight-BDF map
Maintenance, workload drain, reboot and rollback procedure
Independent OOB access and protected evidence path
safety_requirements: Confirm security authority and known-good rollback before disablement
Capture enabled/previous state and all affected GPU/workload mappings
Do not change firmware/cmdline or reboot without explicit approval
Stop on unexpected translation state, boot failure, missing/unbound GPU, PCIe/XGMI, thermal, power or security issue
Preserve evidence and restore only through the approved OOB plan
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre/post BIOS/OOB, cmdline and runtime IOMMU/DMAR evidence
Verify amdgpu module/version, every stable BDF binding and AMD-SMI visibility
Review complete untruncated platform logs for DMA and driver faults
Do not approve the security exception, alter settings autonomously or issue DUT PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Assign a unique code or approve the distinct row143/row407 variants
Approve disabled-mode semantics, security exception and reboot/rollback plan
Resolve security, boot, DMA or GPU-state anomalies and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A dmesg grep is supporting evidence only and cannot prove firmware state, effective IOMMU disablement, accepted security posture or all GPU bindings.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the approved change/reboot, capture firmware/OOB evidence, complete `/proc/cmdline`, platform-specific disabled-mode/IOMMU/DMAR status, module state, per-BDF bindings, AMD-SMI inventory and untruncated logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The IOMMU-disabled condition, driver-load acceptance and source 10/20 timing remain required.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Audit the security exception and prove the disabled state across firmware, boot and runtime layers before accepting complete per-BDF driver operation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit security authority and recovery proof without changing the source configuration branch.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The row407 field-health diagnostic remains independent and cannot replace disabled-mode evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Platform firmware may expose ambiguous IOMMU modes; absence of a log line is not proof of disablement.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must resolve the row143/row407 duplicate identity and define a verifiable disabled mode plus accepted security scope; it may not infer disablement from silence or merge the field-health test into this checkpoint.
expected_evidence: Pre/post BIOS/OOB evidence and complete cmdline
Runtime disabled-mode/IOMMU/DMAR status and absence/interpretation of translation domains
Kernel/amdgpu/ROCm versions plus every expected GPU BDF binding and visibility
Complete dmesg/syslog/SEL, recovery readiness and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Elevates IOMMU disablement from a short log search to a security-approved, recoverable configuration proof joined to complete GPU driver health.
independent_technical_reasoning: No IOMMU message may mean disabled, unsupported logging or an evidence gap; it cannot be the sole oracle. Because disabling translation changes the DMA trust boundary, proof must include authorized policy, active firmware/boot/runtime state and stable per-BDF driver operation after reboot. The duplicate field-health row tests another layer and must remain distinct.
